findings.title: The shared300s absolute outer cap still does not supervise the controller restoration and outer shell restore
findings.evidence: launch() bounds the nested systemd-run wait, but direct_restore() synchronously Path.write_text()s parent memory.max and memory.swap.max with no deadline supervisor. within_absolute_outer_deadline is only logged after those calls return. The DATA64 root controller unit itself has no RuntimeMaxSec or independent absolute watchdog. Both EXIT traps and the always step also run systemctl set-property with no timeout or remaining-deadline bound. timeout-minutes:20 is not the required shared300s cap.
findings.failure_trace: On timeout/stop, cgroup.kill signals the build descendants, then a synchronous lowering of memory.max can spend time reclaiming still-charged memory or be killed with the slice. A reserved5s interval cannot bound that syscall. If it stalls, code cannot reach the later expired check or bounded D-Bus cleanup. Even after a successful direct restore, a stalled outer set-property can keep the A/B stage waiting past the same deadline. Thus the nested build wait is bounded, but the claimed startup/stop/restore-inclusive outer300s is not established.
findings.basis: Static control-flow finding, not an executed reproduction. Linux cgroup-v2 documents synchronous reclaim/OOM behavior on memory.max unless O_NONBLOCK is used; systemd TimeoutStartSec/StopSec are service lifecycle limits, not a watchdog on the active root controller's blocking restoration.
findings.required_change: Provide a bounded restoration and outer-controller/launch cleanup path supervised against the same immutable absolute deadline, including timeout/failure paths. Preserve actual512MiB/swap0 restoration before DATA, all resource aggregation, original Source/first4steps and manual-only trigger. A late boolean/log or20-minute job timeout is not closure. Do not merely kill the controller while leaving an elevated parent; if bounded restore cannot be established, keep plan unapproved and do not execute.
findings.acceptance: Full new exact workflow/plan review must show bounded startup, build stop and actual aggregate restore with no unbounded management operation outside the same deadline; no project run authorized by this review.

official_semantic_references.observed: RuntimeMaxSec applies active service time, default infinity; startup and stop timeouts have separate semantics.
